content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to use [product_name] and [product_name] V20 to control a three-phase motor with a power of 0.37kW? Thank you
Hello, You can use the analog signal from [product_name] to control the [product_name] V20.
Is the analog signal used for controlling motor speed? Would you use a potentiometer for this, and can commands from [product_name] be sent to the digital inputs of the [product_name] V20?

Hello, here’s how you can proceed: 1- Send a 0-10V analog signal from [product_name] to the VSD terminals ('AI1 and 0V' or 'AI2 and 0V') to manage motor speed. 2- The enable ('start') digital input signal can go from [product_name] or another device to the VSD. 3- You may also connect a potentiometer to the VSD terminals ('10V, AI1, and 0V') for direct motor speed control.

You can operate the V20 using two buttons for start and stop if preferred. Speed control may be achieved through digital options, analog/potentiometer, or via communication. However, [product_name] cannot be used for communication control in this setup. It is recommended to review the [product_name] V20 manual and check the connection preset configurations (CNxxx) to determine which configuration fits your specific control needs.
